digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate — E2 seeded-defect evaluation harness
propositions: Seeded-defect mutant corpus with five defect classes (absent capability, layer-cake split, consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge, unnecessary mechanism, untagged AC) was deterministically assembled from real cleanly-closed plans with paired controls to enable ground-truth evaluation of gate detection power without circular LLM adjudication.

Mutation-assembly harness, pure counting helpers (classify_pair, run_validity), pre-registered thresholds, and golden tests were designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e2 but intentionally NOT landed on main because the harness only drives the rejected batch baseline.

Live ~100-run LLM batch baseline sweep producing e2_baseline.json and e2_verdicts.jsonl was permanently rejected on cost grounds and superseded by story d8a5 (change #798, MERGED), which accumulates detection and blocking-FP signal from real production reviews at zero marginal LLM cost via criterion_effectiveness.py.

Store-isolation mechanism implemented by construction using standalone git clone --local --branch tickets (own .git directory, not linked-worktree) to prevent mutation commits from contaminating the real .tickets-tracker.
History-mining for baseline construction is dead due to impact_model_version stranding: only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist against ~200 needed, rendering retroactive corpus assembly infeasible.
